name: Pointe West Apartments
notes: No Blacksburg complex by this name was found. 'Pointe West' is Pointe West Management, a Blacksburg property manager (now merged with Granite Student Living) that manages scattered units. Its listings are covered under stonegate-carlton-scott, landing-at-stonegate, pheasant-run, university-terrace and oak-manor (granitesl.appfolio.com, where units show 'Application Fee: $49'). A separate 'Pointe West' complex exists in Christiansburg (1380 Providence Blvd), which is outside Blacksburg. The pointewestmanagement.com homepage returned no text (JS-rendered).
